advice_items.quote: you also need to be physically fit you have to treat your body as it is a machine
advice_items.summary_en: Learn martial arts for self-defense and stay physically fit by treating your body like a machine.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学习格斗防身并保持体魄，像机器一样保养身体

advice_items.quote: so many people out there are stuck into the preparation mode because they are scared shitless to actually take that first step
advice_items.summary_en: Preparation means nothing without action; stop staying stuck in prep mode and take the first step.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别只停留在准备阶段，要克服恐惧迈出第一步

advice_items.quote: I was scared shitless every single time but I did it to prove to myself that I had what it takes to face my opponents to face my fears
advice_items.summary_en: Build courage by stepping into hard situations despite fear to prove to yourself you can handle them.
advice_items.summary_zh: 主动迎接挑战直面恐惧，在实战中建立自信

advice_items.quote: put him in martial arts because all the good coaches out there are mentors
advice_items.summary_en: Online advice isn't enough; seek real-world mentors such as experienced martial arts coaches.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别只看线上内容，要在现实中寻找真正的好导师

advice_items.quote: you don't want to wait until you have a family in order to become a provider you need to start way before the family ever gets into the picture
advice_items.summary_en: Develop the ability to earn and provide financially well before you start a family.
advice_items.summary_zh: 成家前就要及早培养赚钱养家的能力与责任感

advice_items.quote: you only control three things in life your emotions your actions and your reactions
advice_items.summary_en: Practice stoic temperance and self-mastery by focusing only on your emotions, actions, and reactions.
advice_items.summary_zh: 修习节制与自控，只掌控情绪、行动与反应

advice_items.quote: faith in yourself faith in something bigger than yourself
advice_items.summary_en: Cultivate faith in yourself and a higher force to stay grounded and achieve your goals.
advice_items.summary_zh: 培养对自我和更高力量的信念，坚信终将有所成

guests.role_or_title: Martial Arts Coach & Men's Mentor / Content Creator
guests.zero_start_advice: 年轻男性应掌握五项核心能力：学习格斗防身并保持体魄、克服恐惧迈出行动第一步、在现实中寻找良师（如武术教练）、成家前及早培养养家能力、修习情绪与言行自控（节制），以及保持对自我和更高力量的信念。
